Name: Mist Wolf
Description: A vicious denizen of The Blackwood, capable of vanishing into the shadows.

Name: Blackwood Bandits
Description: A band of outlaws, known around these parts for preying upon unprepared travelers.

Name: The Witch of Blackwood
Description: An immortal agent of chaos, armed with brews and hexes.

Name: Plagued Peasants
Description: These townsfolk keep following you... None of them have spoken a word.

Name: Rats
Description: I'm the giant rat that makes all of the rules!

Name: The Dark One
Description: The king's loyal servant, said to wield dark magic more powerful than that of any sorcerer.

Name: Castle Gate
Description: Archers defend the wall, while guards block the way.

Name: Courtyard Sorcerers
Description: Cryomancers freeze intruders where they stand, protected by powerful shielding magic.

Name: The King's Court
Description: The king responsible for never-ending Winter, surrounded by legendary warriors.

Name: True Winter King
Description: With the King's Court defeated, the king reveals his true form...
